currentlyReading.author: J. K. Rowling

reviews.title: King of Wrath
reviews.author: Ana Huang
reviews.text: This book had me in a chokehold. The tension, the obsession, the payoff — everything I love in a dark romance. Every chapter felt like a slow descent into something I had no intention of escaping.

reviews.title: The Silent Patient
reviews.author: Alex Michaelides
reviews.text: A quiet storm of a novel. Every chapter feels like descending another stair into something darker and more brilliant. The ending rearranged my entire understanding of the book.

reviews.title: A Court of Thorns and Roses
reviews.author: Sarah J. Maas
reviews.text: So addictive. The world-building, the tension, the characters... I get the hype now. I lost an entire weekend to this one and I would do it again without hesitation.

reviews.title: Brutal Prince
reviews.author: Sophie Lark
reviews.text: Dark, intense and so well written. It was the perfect mix of obsession, power and vulnerability. The arranged-marriage setup had no business being this compelling.

reviews.title: Fourth Wing
reviews.author: Rebecca Yarros
reviews.text: Dragons, danger, and a heartbeat that refuses to settle. Chaos in the best possible binding. I finished it at 3am and immediately wanted to start over.
